robot.identity_classification: F1 is a project codename; all functional identifiers and the single robot model are x1/xyber_x1. No F1-vs-X1 functional mismatch.

joint_order.source_of_truth: URDF dof_names == env action order == motion_lib X1_JOINT_NAMES

amp_obs.expert_policy_parity: expert (MotionLib.build_amp_obs_numpy) and policy (X1AMPEnv.compute_amp_obs) use ONE identical feature layout; all quantities in base frame.
amp_obs.foot_contact_source: policy: contact_forces[feet_indices,2] > 5.0; expert: clip foot_contact column or height-based fallback

discriminator.style_reward: r = clamp(1 - 0.25*(ema(D(expert)) - D(policy)), 0, 2); correct sign (rises as policy logit -> expert)

training_state_resume.note: policy replay buffer contents intentionally NOT persisted (transient reservoir); restored empty to avoid all-zero-sample corruption.
